items.title: Impact Biomedical, Inc. Announces U.S. Patent Allowance of Laetose™ Technology Entitled “Low Glycemic Sugar Composition.”
items.summary: NEW YORK, Jan. 30, 2024 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Impact Biomedical Inc. (IBIO), in which DSS Inc. (NYSE American: DSS) has a significant investment, is thrilled to announce a milestone in its innovative Laetose™ technology platform. The U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) has issued U.S. patent # 11,898,184, entitled "Low Glycemic Sugar Composition" developed within this platform.
